claim_boundary: These proposals encode verified process lessons from a completed frozen experiment. They do not generalize the negative Dk64/Dk96 result beyond the tested Qwen3.6-27B Ascend TP4 serving workload.

proposals.proposal: For hybrid-attention models, derive the treatment layer set from the checkpoint's declared layer_types and validate its cardinality. Never infer layer IDs from the count alone.
proposals.evidence: Qwen3.6-27B exposes 48 linear-attention layers among 64 total layers, with non-contiguous IDs because every fourth layer is full attention.

proposals.proposal: For DRRQR reproduction, capture the post-convolution Q and K activations that define the paper's channel-selection matrix, and audit the full layer x TP-rank x sample Cartesian product before conversion.
proposals.evidence: The accepted capture contains exactly 3072 artifacts = 48 x 4 x 16, with indexes 0-15 present for every layer/rank pair.

proposals.proposal: Record unavailable paper resources explicitly and give any substitute calibration corpus a new, hash-bound adaptation identity. Do not describe adapted calibration as paper-exact.
proposals.evidence: FineWeb-Edu was unavailable; the experiment uses a frozen 16x2048-token LongBench-v2 adaptation with its own SHA256.

proposals.proposal: Require a real-weight smoke proving both checkpoint shape and the intended runtime kernel/dimension before collecting A/B metrics.
proposals.evidence: The accepted smoke returned HTTP 200 and exact response ASCEND_DRRQR_OK while the runtime logged head_k_dim=64.

proposals.proposal: Treat the paper's 50% state reduction as the primary hypothesis, not a guaranteed operating point. If repeated quality loss exceeds the observed baseline repeat range, evaluate 20-30% pruning as a separately identified treatment.
proposals.evidence: The operator predeclared Dk96 (25% pruning) as the first fallback; no fallback result may be pooled with Dk64.

proposals.proposal: Keep paper training microbenchmarks, colleague serving references and current Ascend serving results in separate denominators; compare direction only when model, hardware, topology and workload differ.
proposals.evidence: The paper's 1.32x result is an H100 sequence-mixer training microbenchmark, while this experiment is full-model vLLM serving on four Ascend 910B4 cards.

proposals.proposal: Before labeling an algorithm failure, record whether the model loaded, whether measurement began, and whether the error belongs to shell quoting, packaging, source-image ABI, resource collision, runtime activation or scientific outcome.
proposals.evidence: Multiple rejected attempts failed before measurement; the repaired Dk64 smoke and baseline performance later succeeded under the same scientific hypothesis.

proposals.proposal: Run expensive native profiling only after the candidate passes every preregistered quality gate. If quality fails, record profiling as intentionally skipped rather than missing.
proposals.evidence: Dk96 failed GSM8K by 0.303260 pp versus a 0.151630 pp baseline range, so the frozen protocol rejected it without consuming a second baseline/treatment profiling cycle.

proposals.proposal: Report favorable means and repeat separation as distinct facts. Never promote an overlapping three-run mean change to a stable acceleration claim.
proposals.evidence: Dk96 changed TTFT -0.401006%, TPOT -0.442686%, output throughput +0.380717% and duration -0.327093%, but every baseline/treatment three-run interval overlapped.

proposals.proposal: Preserve failed pruning ratios as first-class decisions. A milder fallback is a new treatment, not a replacement for an inconvenient primary result.
proposals.evidence: Dk64 (50%) and Dk96 (25%) were independently built and measured. Both passed structural/runtime audits and LongBench-v2, but both failed the frozen GSM8K gate and remain separately traceable.

proposals.proposal: Separate four conclusions: source identity, mechanism activation, measured platform effect and adoption. Successful conversion/loading proves feasibility, not paper-exact benefit.
proposals.evidence: Official Strong RRQR selection produced valid Dk64/Dk96 checkpoints and real Ascend service responses, while quality failed and the paper's H100 training microbenchmark was not a same-denominator serving comparison.
